# EPIC — TRI-NET 2026 Scientific Improvement Plan (e-engine)

**Local plan ID:** `EPIC-0` (placeholder — see "ID convention" below)
**Scope:** TRI-1 Euler (this repo)
**Plan source:** [`docs/SCIENTIFIC_IMPROVEMENT_PLAN.md`](../../docs/SCIENTIFIC_IMPROVEMENT_PLAN.md)
**Honesty contract:** preserves R5 — every row labelled `target` / `projection` / `VERIFY` per the SIP preamble.

> **ID convention — important.** The `#0` / `#1` / ... numbers used in this
> directory are **local plan IDs** that pair 1-to-1 with the file name
> (`00_EPIC_2026.md`, `01_CL-01_*.md`, …). They are **NOT GitHub issue
> numbers**. No GitHub issue exists for any of these until
> [`create_issues.sh`](create_issues.sh) is run and `gh issue create`
> returns a real issue URL. Until then, treat the IDs as placeholders for
> tracking inside this branch.

---

## Why this EPIC exists

The TRI-NET 2026 plan in [`docs/SCIENTIFIC_IMPROVEMENT_PLAN.md`](../../docs/SCIENTIFIC_IMPROVEMENT_PLAN.md)
defines five tracks (CL / EN / SN / PUB / OS) with 16 rows. This EPIC
collects the per-row work items so they can be filed as GitHub issues in
a single, idempotent pass. The actual work and acceptance criteria for
each row are duplicated below in compact form and live in full inside the
SIP file — the SIP is authoritative.

This EPIC **does not** restate any anti-claim or any numeric figure. It
points at the SIP for those.

## How to file these as real GitHub issues

```bash
# Dry-run (no GitHub calls — just prints what would happen):
./.github/issues/create_issues.sh --dry-run

# Real creation (requires gh CLI authenticated; idempotent — skips titles
# that already exist as open issues in this repo):
./.github/issues/create_issues.sh
```

See [`create_issues.sh`](create_issues.sh) for flags and safety notes.

---

## What this EPIC explicitly does NOT claim

- **No GitHub issue numbers exist** for any row until the creator script
  has been run successfully. The `#0..#16` IDs are local placeholders.
- **No funding** / **no programme date** / **no silicon-return date** /
  **no paper acceptance** / **no new DOI** / **no `1000×` / `4000 TOPS/W`
  as fact** — per [`docs/SCIENTIFIC_IMPROVEMENT_PLAN.md`](../../docs/SCIENTIFIC_IMPROVEMENT_PLAN.md) §10.
- **No row promoted** in [STATUS.md](../../STATUS.md) or
  [BENCHMARKS.md](../../BENCHMARKS.md). Promotions happen when the work
  lands, not when an issue is filed.
- **No `.github/workflows/` change.** Filing issues never touches CI.

---

## Acceptance criteria for this EPIC

This EPIC is considered "complete" when all 16 child rows are either:

- closed because the work landed (with a reproducible artefact added to
  [STATUS.md §3](../../STATUS.md)), or
- closed as "deferred" with a one-line justification (and the SIP row
  updated accordingly).

The EPIC is **not** closed by the act of filing the child issues. Filing
is mechanical; the EPIC tracks completion.
